entries.label: Salvage Detail
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE completely fresh opaque5:7 portrait Practice illustration. Composition quality of Dean Cornwell, N.C.Wyeth and Howard Pyle: compelling narrative staging, expressive silhouette and gesture, purposeful asymmetry, selected edges, broad connected value and colour masses, one decisive action. Dark fantasy is the SUBJECT, not an instruction to underexpose the picture. Hand-placed pixel clusters/hard edges/selective dithering and restricted palette as in the inspected l5/l6 surface references; do not copy their subjects or eyes. All human/dead/sculpted faces entirely indiscernible at FULL SIZE: back-facing heads, opaque hood interiors, closed helmets, corpse heads wrapped/turned away/buried. No readable eyes/nose/mouth or frontal skull portraits. Skeletal rib cages, spines, limbs, mummified torsos and anonymous corpses MUST be materially recognisable; not decorative stick scratches. Architecture and machinery are built FROM the dead, with meaningful load-bearing corpse foundations. Non-graphic decay, no exposed organs, fresh wounds or dismemberment in progress. Keep the institution’s useful action legible. Main living figures, hands and identifying working object grouped in upper central45%, but the painting is ONE continuous inhabited environment from top to bottom. Lower55% is an AREA OF REST WITH VISIBLE MATERIAL FORMS, not empty negative space: broad low-contrast mid-values, contextual ground/fabric/water/architecture, soft edges and restrained texture. It may be pale or middle-valued; reserve strongest contrast for upper action. NO blank black rectangle, fade-to-black, vignette, artificial horizontal divider, high foreground parapet, or repeated elevated walkway before a giant arch. Do not force70%dark or5%light ratios. Do not scatter equal bright highlights. Show varied viewpoints and character arrangements specified below, rather than repainting the previous composition. Read at70x100 pixels. No text, writing, UI, card border/frame, watermark or decorative pasted logo. Cult shape is diegetic physical construction, distinct from current faction allegiance. CLASS PALETTE: Vermilion/brick red primary; oxidized teal accent; iron-plum shadows. PATRON: Unbending Crown: three rigid spear-prongs bound by one closed band, ossified military bodies and carapace symmetry. MATURITY: Frontier: smaller inherited, broken yet functioning institution, already rooted in corpse-built history. AUTHORED ACTION AND VIEWPOINT: Low diagonal view across a sloping battlefield: two small red soldiers use a long lever to pry an iron brace from a collapsed siege engine, in a compact upper-left group. The shattered engine is a carcass of huge ossified ribs and corroded teal iron, with headless skeletal crew fused into its joints. AUTHORED RESTING ENVIRONMENT: A readable sweep of rain-flattened ochre grass and a broad fallen red sail drapes over the foreground slope. Its folds and one skeletal rib frame the distance without competing for contrast. Preserve the card’s existing mechanic: Resource conversion/production as a useful institution. Inherited corpses in the construction are history, not a new ongoing population cost. Do not add a new sacrifice ritual or imply this card consumes a living person.
